gap_name: Hierarchical NTFS Case-Safe Resource Lock Manager
production_defect: Production NoStackingDetector performs exact-string matching on taskId and command. It does not normalize Windows path casing (e.g. C:\Repo vs c:\repo) nor does it perform hierarchical parent/child directory containment checks, permitting concurrent write operations on overlapping filesystem subtrees.
concrete_counterexample: Worker A locks C:\Users\lol\courier\data; Worker B locks C:\users\lol\courier\data\output. Production treats them as non-conflicting keys, allowing concurrent execution and corrupting the output directory.
shadow_solution: Implemented ResourceLockManager with path normalization, lowercase case-folding, and hierarchical subpath containment checks (parent lock blocks child, child lock blocks parent, independent sibling directories permitted).
test_verification_ref: Scenario 1 (Parent/child filesystem conflict blocked), Scenario 2 (NTFS case collision blocked), Scenario 3 (Independent resources run concurrently) in MANDATORY_SCENARIOS_REPORT.json

gap_name: Process Lease Identity Tuple and Fail-Closed Destruction
production_defect: Production ProcessLeaseManager keys active leases solely by integer PID. When a worker process terminates and the operating system recycles its PID to an unrelated process (e.g. svchost.exe or an IDE helper), supervisor cleanup signals process.kill(pid), terminating an innocent process. Furthermore, UNKNOWN processes default to unhandled or unsafe termination.
concrete_counterexample: Worker process PID 4520 terminates. Windows recycles PID 4520 for an OS background service. Supervisor triggers hung-process cleanup and executes process.kill(4520), crashing an OS service.
shadow_solution: Integrated composite process identity tuple (PID, START_TIME, TASK_TOKEN) with a 2000ms start-time drift tolerance. safeTerminateProcess explicitly returns can_terminate=false for UNKNOWN processes or recycled PIDs with start-time mismatch.
test_verification_ref: Scenario 4 (PID reuse mismatch blocked), Scenario 5 (Unknown process identity blocks kill), Scenario 6 (Stale task token blocked) in MANDATORY_SCENARIOS_REPORT.json

production_defect: Production decision engine dispatches work units without an authoritative pre-flight capability check or cryptographic passport stamping. Rogue workers or unsynchronized dispatchers can initiate uncoordinated work units without verified resource lock ownership.
concrete_counterexample: Dispatcher submits work unit without verified mutex acquisition. A second dispatcher launches conflicting work on the same target directory, causing race conditions.
shadow_solution: Implemented BorderGuard.evaluatePreDispatch() which checks active leases, verifies ResourceLockManager locks, and stamps an authoritative, HMAC-signed TaskPassport before execution is permitted.
test_verification_ref: Scenario 9 (Unstamped dispatch rejected with MISSING_SIGNATURE), Scenario 10 (Stale TaskPassport rejected), Scenario 18 (Human Gate enforced) in MANDATORY_SCENARIOS_REPORT.json

gap_name: ResultCustoms Post-Execution Envelope and Evidence Verifier
production_defect: Production progress tracker accepts worker result claims without cryptographically verifying passport signatures or validating that declared output artifacts exist and match declared SHA-256 hashes on disk. A faulty worker can report completion with fabricated or missing files.
concrete_counterexample: Worker reports task status DONE with output file references that do not exist or contain 0 bytes. Supervisor marks task complete, and downstream consumer fails.
shadow_solution: Implemented ResultCustoms envelope inspection and EvidenceVerifier, verifying HMAC signature, passport version, non-zero exit codes, and computing real SHA-256 disk checksums of all declared output files.
test_verification_ref: Scenario 11 (Malformed envelope rejected), Scenario 12 (Stale result rejected), Scenario 13 (Empty artifact manifest rejected) in MANDATORY_SCENARIOS_REPORT.json

gap_name: Worker Global Completion Authority Revocation & CompletionGovernor
production_defect: Production allows individual worker processes to report global mission completion (status=DONE), leading to premature shutdown when only a subset of sub-tasks have actually executed.
concrete_counterexample: Worker finishes task 5 of 50 and outputs global status DONE. Supervisor accepts the claim and terminates the run prematurely (the exact bug observed in early missions).
shadow_solution: Implemented CompletionGovernor which completely revokes worker global completion authority. Completion is strictly reserved for the supervisor after all sub-tasks have passed ResultCustoms verification.
test_verification_ref: Scenario 14 (Worker DONE claim rejected; global mission preserved) in MANDATORY_SCENARIOS_REPORT.json
